1849-2105-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1849-2105-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-2105-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

413-3652-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
413-3652-5006-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. When Ornithopter enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

2793-3743-5089-5636-7824.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-5636-7824.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

2034-2350-4871-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Stone Calendar.
Repeat.

2349-2724-3080-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
2349-2724-3080-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Mistmeadow Witch by paying {2}{W}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7175-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-7175-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

2457-4289-4365-4742.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

562-4924-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat.

1358-1978-3053.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1358-1978-3053.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Sydri.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

813-4377-5895.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Splash Portal.
813-4377-5895.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

478-804-2821-4241-4249.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-4241-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
478-804-2821-4241-4249.description:
Animate Candelabra using Karn
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-2350-3363-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

1766-1978-3488.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using Katsumasa.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

864-2639-3254-4871-5147.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
864-2639-3254-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one non-Human creature.
864-2639-3254-4871-5147.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable, putting it on top of a non-Human creature you control.
When Nethroi enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nethroi.
When Nethroi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Nethroi trigger from step 2, returning Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nethroi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime.
When Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Mitotic Slime triggers once.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, they each trigger and Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Ooze triggers, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate the seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G/W}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3371-4222-5385.manaNeeded: {4}{U}, plus enough mana to pay for the nonland card's mana cost minus {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
3371-4222-5385.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one instant and/or sorcery card in hand.
3371-4222-5385.description:
Cast Aura Finesse by paying {U}, attaching the Aura to Codie and drawing a card (this is necessary because Codie's ability forces you to cast the Aura before Codie is on the battlefield).
Activate Codie by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate the Aura by paying {U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times, skipping step 3 on the final iteration.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 2.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

1567-3086-4605-4681.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying {1}{W}, blinking Lagrella.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Preston triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Karmic Guide until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Lagrella that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Lagrella into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide, Lagrella and Preston each trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choosing to return nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger from step 8, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

719-1821-3000.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
"Phyrexian" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1821-3000.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
When the creature entes the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Xenograft, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat step 2.

1656-4899-4968.notablePrerequisites: The combined mana value of cards in you library is greater than or equal to the sum of your opponents' life totals.
1656-4899-4968.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer's ability repeatedly to exile your entire library, adding a number of counter to it equal to the mana value of the exiled cards.
Use Deathbringer Thoctar's ability to remove +1/+1 counters to deal 1 damage to any target until your opponent are dead.

2816-3291.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Karametra's Acolyte.
2816-3291.notablePrerequisites: Karametra's Acolyte does not have summoning sickness. Your devotion to green is at least 3.
2816-3291.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

893-2034-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.
